t: # Short Obligatory Prayer ## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon. Nguwichila umboni O Mlungu jwangu! Kuti Mwanenjile une, kuti nim'manyilile nikumpopela. Ngwitichisya pa-je ndawi jino, kulembuka kwangu niukulu wa machili Genu, kulaga kwangu nikupuka Kwenu. Pangali Mlungu jwine akawe M'mwe Jikape, Wakamusya muyakogoya.
